tagline: Eighty-seven miles around the longest of the Finger Lakes.
intro: The loop leaves the north end of Cayuga Lake and runs down the west shore by Canoga, Interlaken and Trumansburg to Ithaca at the south end, then back up the east side through King Ferry, Aurora and Union Springs. The lake beside it is just under 39 miles long and never more than three and a half miles across.

The glaciers left it steep at the sides and shallow at the ends, with a wide marsh at the north. Seneca Falls, near the north end, held the convention that became a foundational event of the women's rights movement, and some believe the town was the model for Bedford Falls in It's a Wonderful Life.

moments.title: Taughannock Falls State Park
moments.text: Near a 215-foot plunge waterfall, workmen in 1879 dug up a seven-foot petrified giant, and over 5,000 people paid to see the hotel owner's hoax.

moments.title: Aurora
moments.text: A lake port of the canal days, where Henry Wells founded a college for women in 1868 that took men from 2005 and closed in 2024.

moments.title: Union Springs
moments.text: Offshore lies Frontenac Island, a clump of trees over a Late Archaic site from about 2000 BC, nearly a third of which went into a railroad embankment in 1859.

sources.label: Wikipedia, Aurora, Cayuga County, New York
